metadata.question: Does the number of fire hotspots in the Paraná River delta from January through July 22, 2020, exceed those detected during the same period in 2019?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does the number of fire hotspots in the Paraná River delta from January through July 22, 2020, exceed those detected during the same period in 2019?" We need to: 1. Search for fire hotspot data - likely MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire (MODIS/006/MCD14DL) or VIIRS Active Fires (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1) 2. Define geometry for Paraná River delta (Argentina) 3. Time periods: 2019-01-01 to 2019-07-22 and 2020-01-01 to 2020-07-22 4. Count fire pixels in each period and compare Data selection: - MODIS MCD14DL (1km daily) or VIIRS VNP14A1 (375m daily) for fire hotspots - Use the "confidence" band or "FireMask" to identify fire pixels - Count pixels with confidence > threshold (e.g., >=30 for nominal confidence) Strategy: 1. Use VIIRS Active Fires (VNP14A1) for better resolution 2. Filter by date and region 3. Count fire pixels in each period 4. Compare counts: if 2020 > 2019 → A (Yes), else B (No) Considerations: - Check if collections are empty → C1 - Check if no fire pixels after masking → C2 (valid zero) - Ensure calculation returns valid numbers → C3 Geometry: Paraná River delta is in Argentina, roughly: [-59.5, -33.0, -58.5, -32.0] Let's create a polygon around this area. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Paraná River delta geometry var delta = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [-59.5, -32.0], [-59.5, -33.0], [-58.5, -33.0], [-58.5, -32.0], [-59.5, -32.0] ]); // 2. Define time periods var start2019 = '2019-01-01'; var end2019 = '2019-07-23'; // Exclusive, so use 23rd to include 22nd var start2020 = '2020-01-01'; var end2020 = '2020-07-23'; // 3. Use VIIRS Active Fires (375m daily) for fire detection var fires2019 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') .filterDate(start2019, end2019) .filterBounds(delta) .select('FireMask'); var fires2020 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14A1') .filterDate(start2020, end2020) .filterBounds(delta) .select('FireMask'); // 4. Check collection sizes var count2019 = fires2019.size().getInfo(); var count2020 = fires2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${count2019}, 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); // If either collection is empty, try MODIS as fallback if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('Trying MODIS MCD14DL as fallback...'); fires2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(start2019, end2019) .filterBounds(delta) .select('confidence'); fires2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(start2020, end2020) .filterBounds(delta) .select('confidence'); count2019 = fires2019.size().getInfo(); count2020 = fires2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS 2019 Images: ${count2019}, 2020 Images: ${count2020}`); } // If still empty, output C1 if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Process fire pixels: VIIRS FireMask values 7-9 = fire, MODIS confidence >=30 = fire var isVNP = fires2019.first().bandNames().getInfo().includes('FireMask'); var fire2019, fire2020; if (isVNP) { // VIIRS: FireMask values 7,8,9 = fire fire2019 = fires2019.map(function(img) { var fire = img.gte(7).and(img.lte(9)); return fire.rename('fire'); }).sum(); fire2020 = fires2020.map(function(img) { var fire = img.gte(7).and(img.lte(9)); return fire.rename('fire'); }).sum(); } else { // MODIS: confidence >=30 = fire fire2019 = fires2019.map(function(img) { var fire = img.gte(30); return fire.rename('fire'); }).sum(); fire2020 = fires2020.map(function(img) { var fire = img.gte(30); return fire.rename('fire'); }).sum(); } // 6. Count fire pixels in each period var countFire2019 = fire2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: delta, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('fire').getInfo(); var countFire2020 = fire2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: delta, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('fire').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixel counts if (countFire2019 === null || countFire2020 === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Round to integers countFire2019 = Math.round(countFire2019); countFire2020 = Math.round(countFire2020); console.log(`Fire hotspots 2019: ${countFire2019}`); console.log(`Fire hotspots 2020: ${countFire2020}`); // 7. Validate and output answer if (isNaN(countFire2019) || isNaN(countFire2020)) { console.log('C3'); } else if (countFire2019 === 0 && countFire2020 === 0) { console.log('C2'); } else if (countFire2020 > countFire2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
